# Finatix

> Online CIMA training platform — courses, mock exams, AI study tools and competency analytics covering every paper from Certificate (BA1–BA4) to Strategic Case Study.

Finatix helps students preparing for the CIMA qualification practice, track readiness and pass exams faster with adaptive study tools and tutor support.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and CIMA training intro.
- [Why CIMA](/why-cima): Career value and benefits of the CIMA qualification.
- [Courses](/courses): Full directory of CIMA papers (BA1–BA4, E1–E3, P1–P3, F1–F3, OCS, MCS, SCS).
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription plans for individuals and corporate teams.
- [About](/about): Mission, team and approach.
- [Contact](/contact): Support, sales and FAQ.
- [Help Centre](/help): Common questions and platform guides.
- [Learning Paths](/learning-paths): Structured study routes through the qualification.
